title: Chuckles takes up the vibraphone
summary: Chuckles learned the vibraphone and they were made honorary musicians' union members; Green compares dancers on xylophone and vibraphone.

story.theme_name: The musicians' union: cards, locals, and the Black-white merger
story.community_name: The musicians' union: cards, scale and the black-white merger

blocks.x: So Chuck and Chuckles now are on their own. What did your -- what were some of the things that you used to do, now, at this particular time, as an act?

Well, we introduced new songs and new tap dances and so on. And Chuckles eventually learned how to play a musical instrument, which was the vibraphone. And we had become honorary musicians by being with Buck and Bubbles. They made us members of the musicians' union. And most of the unions at that time.
He played the vibraphone. He didn't tap dance?
Because I know there are tap dancers that do that.

Yes, there was one -- well, there was originally two. I mean, the vibraphone. Will Mahoney danced on the xylophone or the marimba, and then there was a newcomer, Jimmy Smith, he's the one that danced on the vibraphone. But he made this, you know, by hand. He made the instrument himself.
